stage: protocol written and hashed before execution
fixed_model: unit M=I,k=(1,1,1),b=ones,ell=(0,-1,1),f=-a; reuse frozen omega/rho/S/zeta_star without solving spectrum

definitions.T_cross: Tenv/delta; sufficient half-duration also needs T>=T0, so report max(T0,T_cross)

pi_method: 12 Chudnovsky terms, Decimal square root, guard precision; standard library only
allowed: constant evaluation and arithmetic crosscheck from the same frozen inputs; four existing delta values only
limits: All reported decimals are approximations to conservative sufficient-condition formulas, not necessary/minimal durations, measured peaks, or directed-interval certificates. A and B have transfer-amplitude units, E amplitude*time, T0/Tenv/T_cross time, C dimensionless.
